verdict.rationale: Mangopay is API-first with an extensive OpenAPI spec, SDKs in 6 languages, sandbox, and webhooks, all pointing to broad API coverage of platform functionality (mangopay-probe-2, mangopay-docs-2, mangopay-docs-21-26). However the docs also describe some actions only via the Dashboard UI (e.g., adding a webhook via 'Developers > Webhooks > Add webhook' in mangopay-docs-15) without confirming an equivalent API path, and there's no explicit statement or independent test confirming full UI/API parity. Missing for 10: an explicit parity statement or feature-by-feature comparison showing every Dashboard action (e.g., KYC review, dispute contestation UI) has an API equivalent, and independent verification of this claim.
